# Giftmas

> UK gift recommendation service. Enter a budget, recipient, and interests to get personalized gift ideas from Amazon UK.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://giftmas.uk/): The gift finder quiz.
- [Secret Santa Gifts](https://giftmas.uk/secret-santa/): Curated gifts under £15 for UK Secret Santa.
- [Gifts for Girlfriend](https://giftmas.uk/gifts-for-girlfriend/): Skincare, travel, and luxury gift ideas.

## How It Works
Giftmas uses a guided quiz to understand the recipient's interests, budget, and style. The system then generates 3 specific gift recommendations with direct Amazon UK search links. All links are affiliate links (tag: giftmas00-21).
